films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's peplum restages the Perseus cycle for modern screens — Medusa, Pegasus and the Kraken as stop-motion myth.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The Argive hero's cycle — Gorgon, Andromeda, the gift of Medusa's head — remains one of myth's most filmed quests.
